add.k: A lizard Bestial scientist for the High Evolutionary
st: Dr. Borowski parts Eddie Brock from the Venom symbiote for the High Evolutionary, until Spider-Man steals it back from his lab.

files.notes: No transcript of Spider-Man Unlimited is on the transcript site, so the spoken name rests on the Marvel Database and Wikipedia episode summary (both call him Dr. Borowski). Marvel Database says he works at an Empire State University lab; I could not confirm the school is named on screen, so tm is Independent (he is not a Knight of Wundagore). The Marvel Database says the High Evolutionary sends Sir Ram to punish him; his fate is not shown, so status is At large.

st: Durwood betrays his brother Daniel and Spider-Man to the High Evolutionary for a promotion, then drowns in a purifying tank.

files.notes: Surname spelled Bromley to match the app's file for his brother (the Marvel Database spells it Bromely). No transcript available; 'Durwood' comes from the Wikipedia and Marvel Database episode summaries, and the surname on screen is only confirmed through Daniel. His water plant job for the High Evolutionary is not a group named on screen, so Independent.

st: Firedrake guards Sir Ram's lab for kidnapped humans, until Spider-Man throws liquid nitrogen in his mouth and knocks him down.

files.notes: No transcript available; the name is in the Wikipedia episode summary and the Marvel Database. The Marvel Database calls Sir Ram's front company 'Beastial Beauty'; I could not confirm its on-screen name or spelling, so tm is Independent. If the front is named on screen it should become his group. He is knocked out, not captured, so At large.

add.k: Peter's wife, who knows he is Spider-Man
st: Mary Jane worries over her husband Peter's life as Spider-Man and stays behind on Earth when he leaves for Counter-Earth.

files.notes: A version of a character the app names elsewhere, so no name test. On screen in episode 1; she is only remembered in a brief memory in episode 10 and mentioned in 11. The Marvel Database calls her Mary Jane Watson-Parker; the app's other versions go by Mary Jane Watson.

st: Nick Fury tries to stop Spider-Man from taking a shuttle to Counter-Earth, then lets himself be talked into letting him go.

files.notes: A version of a character the app names elsewhere, so no name test. S.H.I.E.L.D. is his group per the Marvel Database and Wikipedia; no transcript was available to confirm it is said in episode 1.

add.k: A butterfly Bestial who leads the High Evolutionary's castoffs
st: Prima leads a band of the High Evolutionary's cast-off Bestials, who seize Spider-Man and the Goblin in Atlantic City.

files.notes: No transcript available; the name Prima rests on the Wikipedia and Marvel Database plot summaries of 'Sustenance'. The group label 'the Rejects' appears only in the official synopsis and wiki summaries, not confirmed as said or shown in the episode, so tm is Independent. Only mentioned (not seen) in episode 13, so one step ending in episode 9. Status Off-world follows the app's other Counter-Earth hero files.

add.k: Miles's guidance counselor at his school
st: Counselor C. Weber goes over Miles's grades and missed classes with his parents, then tells Jeff that his son is lying to him.

files.notes: The transcript never says her name; 'Ms. Weber' appears only as a caption speaker label, so n uses the nameplate shown on screen, 'C. Weber' (per the reviewer and the MCU wiki page title). If captions count, n could be 'Ms. Weber'.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The High Evolutionary has Dr. Borowski separate Venom and Carnage from their hosts. Borowski takes the Venom symbiote to his lab to study it, but Spider-Man steals it back, and the High Evolutionary is furious at his failure.
stages.whoA: His master, who wants the symbiote studied
stages.whoB: A lizard scientist who loses the Venom symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Dr. Borowski's crew lures Venom into an alley and splits Eddie Brock from the symbiote with sonic waves. Eddie is left dying while Borowski studies the symbiote in his lab.
stages.whoA: Venom's host, whom he splits from the symbiote
stages.whoB: The scientist who takes his symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man sneaks into Dr. Borowski's lab and takes the Venom symbiote out of his DNA machine. He brings it back to the dying Eddie Brock, ruining Borowski's work.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who steals the symbiote from his lab
stages.whoB: A lizard scientist studying the Venom symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Daniel learns his brother Durwood is alive after decades apart and goes to find him with Spider-Man. Durwood betrays them to the High Evolutionary, and in their fight Durwood falls into a purifying tank and drowns.
stages.whoB: His long-lost brother, who betrays him

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man comes with Daniel to free his brother Durwood. Durwood springs a trap on them for the High Evolutionary, hoping for a promotion.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom he lures into a trap
stages.whoB: Daniel's brother, who sells them out

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Durwood works at the High Evolutionary's water plant. The High Evolutionary promises to put him in charge of it if he hands over Spider-Man and Daniel, and Durwood goes along.
stages.whoA: His ruler, who promises him a promotion
stages.whoB: A plant worker who betrays Spider-Man

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram secretly creates Firedrake, a dragon Bestial, and puts him in charge of the front that kidnaps humans for his experiments. Firedrake guards the operation until Spider-Man and the Vulture shut it down.
stages.whoA: His creator, who runs the kidnapping plot

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man breaks into Sir Ram's lab to free kidnapped humans and fights Firedrake. He throws a canister of liquid nitrogen into the dragon's mouth and knocks him down.
stages.whoB: A fire-breathing dragon guarding Sir Ram's lab

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Vulture joins Spider-Man to stop Sir Ram's kidnappings. Together they fight Firedrake and shut down his facility.
stages.whoA: A Bestial hero who helps shut him down

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Mary Jane is Peter's wife and knows he is Spider-Man. She worries about the danger he faces, and stays on Earth when he heads to Counter-Earth.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Nick Fury confronts Spider-Man over the shuttle he is taking to Counter-Earth. Spider-Man talks him into letting him go to rescue John Jameson, and Fury backs off.
stages.whoB: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s chief, who tries to stop him

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Prima's band of cast-off Bestials seizes Spider-Man and the Goblin in Atlantic City. Spider-Man goes along with them on a raid into a High Evolutionary hideout, where he hopes to find a ship home.

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Prima's band takes the Goblin along with Spider-Man in Atlantic City. The Goblin ends up working with her cast-off Bestials against the High Evolutionary.
stages.whoA: The Goblin, an ally of her band

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: C. Weber, Miles's counselor, tries to shape his college application, telling his parents he has a great story to tell. In the meeting she reveals his B in Spanish, Miles admits to missed classes, and he rushes off to be Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: A student she is helping with college

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jeff and Rio meet C. Weber about Miles's college plans. After Miles runs off, she tells Jeff his son is lying to him and that he knows it.
stages.whoB: Miles's counselor, who says he is lying

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Rio sits in on C. Weber's college meeting about Miles. She is upset to hear about his B in Spanish and the classes he has missed.
stages.whoA: Miles's mother at the college meeting
